Pananos Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Read more Jason Pananos is a Senior Lecturer of Business Administration in the Finance Department. Jason currently teaches and was the co-creator of a second-year field course titled “Value Creation in Small and Medium Firms”. Jason is also an active collaborator and guest lecturer in the courses “Financial Management of Smaller Firms” and “Entrepreneurship through Acquisition”.
